leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a custom Vue composition function (hook) to manage RBAC permissions.
Initialize reactive state within the hook to track user roles and permissions.
Implement computed properties that evaluate permission checks based on the current role.
Integrate the permission hook into a Vue component to control UI visibility.
Apply the hook's methods to conditionally render elements based on user permissions.
Configure the hook to accept dynamic role inputs and update permission evaluations.
Manipulate the component's template to bind permission states to v-if or v-show directives.
